title: Arma 3
summary: Large-scale military sandbox centered on realistic combined-arms combat, open terrain, multiplayer scenarios and extensive community-created content. Reviews consistently frame its realism and flexibility as strengths, while the slow pacing, high lethality and steep learning curve are deliberate but demanding.

observations.statement: Multiplayer, co-op scenarios and the large Workshop ecosystem are recurring reasons players describe the game as unusually long-lived.
Reviews repeatedly describe realistic ballistics, high lethality and a steep learning curve that demand patience and tactical play.
The simulation-oriented pace is repeatedly described as much slower and more deliberate than a conventional action shooter.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index sampled without archiving raw review text
